args.question: Provide the cardholder statement regarding this transaction.

args.narrative: The transaction was captured for 4432 USD on 2026-02-14 with approval 147525. The order was delivered by UPS on 2026-02-18 (delivery proof attached). The disputed amount is 3235 USD of this capture.

args.explanation: Read the case (fraud 4863, chargeback, 45 days left) and the receipt, authorization record and UPS delivery proof. Requested cardholder statement (did not make the purchase). Represented on 2026-02-22 with the three documents, citing the 4432 capture and delivery on 2026-02-18. Waited 10 days; the issuer accepted the representment, so the disputed 3235 was not refunded to the cardholder by the merchant.
